title: Addenda: A Supplemental History — Ex-Students in Their School Days
text:
ADDENDA: A SUPPLEMENTAL HISTORY  29

EX-STUDENTS IN THEIR SCHOOL DAYS

THE McMAHON BROTHERS

[Photograph: two portraits side by side]
Ernest          Will          Robert (Deceased 1941)          Ed

AN ITINERANT SUBSTITUTE TEACHER

Mr. E. A. DeWitt of Dallas wrote under date of July 22, 1941, interestingly of his recollections of the old school at Savoy and of Mr. Habell, as follows: "Two or three years ago, I noticed the story of a reunion of the ex-students of Savoy College. This called to mind a little incident: on my first trip through Texas, about November, 1885, I stopped at Savoy (you should have been, still, an exuberant, a publisher of text books). The morning I went up to the College building I learned that Mr. Pratchett, Principal, had gone away for the day and that teachers were needed. I told them that I would take the classes, a proposition that the teachers accepted. I taught about ten days, as I remember it. It was this experience which led me to say, jestingly, that I was once a professor in Savoy College. The only person I remember was a teacher named Pritchett. During my first year in Texas, I frequently helped out teachers as I did at Savoy."
notes: Page contains two portrait photographs of the McMahon Brothers (Ernest, Will, Robert, Ed) and a text section titled 'An Itinerant Substitute Teacher' — a letter account by E. A. DeWitt of Dallas. The name 'Pratchett'/'Pritchett' appears twice, possibly the same person spelled differently; transcribed as written. Robert is noted as 'Deceased 1941'.
